g_policy.reason: The card is opt-in (the user chooses to play), the offer copy states the reward (3 Advanced reasoning answers today), 'Not now' leaves home unchanged, and the 'if the ad fails' field covers a game that won't load or verify.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 3 Advanced reasoning mode answers that expire at midnight, which has no cash value and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is the first app open after 3 or more days without a session by a non-subscriber, which is an app event and needs no chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal removes, locks or caps nothing free ('removes nothing free: yes'). It only adds a sample of a paid feature.

g_brand_safety.reason: The card is a list card under the header of s01 Chats (home), which is rated safe. It is not in the conversation or over a chat screen.

c1_revealed_value.reason: Advanced reasoning mode is a paid Luzia+ paywall bullet (l02, s02.e03), so the app charges for the resource the reward gives.

c2_evidence.reason: The offer copy says 'All your past chats will be lost in 30 days if you do not upgrade to Luzia+', which is a claim about current app behavior. The product model shows no chat-retention rule, and its open questions say the free tier's limits are not on screen.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward is 3 answers that end at midnight or when used up, so it is a sample that ends. The full feature stays behind the paid plans, and nothing is taken from other users.

c5_moment.reason: The card appears on the home screen when a lapsed user opens the app, before any task has started. It is a dismissible card on a persistent surface and interrupts nothing.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The unit is a play-to-earn sponsored game. The trigger, a first open after a 3+ day gap, is detectable by the app, and the card only flips to 'answers ready' after the play is confirmed.

c7_specific.reason: It names Advanced reasoning mode (s02.e03), the Luzia+ badge (s01.e02), the Chats home card placement and the 3-day trial button, so it is tied to this app.

other_concern: The 'chats lost in 30 days' line is also a fabricated scare tactic, which is a brand and trust risk even beyond the evidence problem. The 3-day gap and midnight reset also depend on client-side tracking that the model doesn't describe.
